tools.name: add_review_comment
tools.description: Add a review comment to a section, authored under the caller's own identity.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a field directly. Refuses with a structured reason for human_only fields (attestations, signatures) and evidence_required fields (use propose_answer instead).

value.description: Stringify numbers/booleans as needed; dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: check_consistency
tools.description: Cross-reference every answered field for contradictions: overlapping dates, an expired passport, income figures that don't add up.

tools.name: explain_requirement
tools.description: Get the plain-language requirement and permission class for one field.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Get overall application progress: sections completed, open questions, and whether it's ready to submit.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Get the full, replayable mutation history for this application — who changed what, in order.

tools.name: get_provenance_report
tools.description: Get who filled every field and when — the full provenance trail.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Get all fields and current values for one section, by section id.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List evidence files attached to this application.

tools.name: list_open_questions
tools.description: List every unanswered or unconfirmed required field — the agent's work queue.

tools.name: list_review_items
tools.description: List reviewer comments across all sections.

tools.name: navigate_to_section
tools.description: Move the active section — affects which section-scoped tools are registered next.

tools.name: propose_answer
tools.description: Propose a value for an evidence_required field (e.g. transcribed from an attached document). Lands as 'needs your confirmation' — never sets the field outright.

tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read an attached evidence file and extract a plain-text summary of what it appears to contain, so the agent can decide what to propose_answer next. Does not modify any field itself.

tools.name: request_evidence
tools.description: Ask the human to attach a document supporting an evidence_required field. The agent cannot attach files itself.

tools.name: request_human_action
tools.description: Escalate to the human: flag a field or general issue that needs their attention. Surfaces in the 'needs you' queue.

tools.name: summarize_application
tools.description: Get a plain-language summary of application progress: what's done, what's outstanding, and any consistency issues found.

tools.name: validate_section
tools.description: Check one section for unanswered required fields.
